answer.rationale: memory_57 is strongest because it directly reports qualified revenue from established customers and no measurable retention harm, supporting sustainability. memory_44 directly supports higher-quality enterprise pipeline, though it omits downstream conversion, retention, and revenue durability. memory_31 and memory_86 show durable activation or adoption improvements, but only indirectly connect to qualified revenue and omit monetization and retention effects. memory_73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but targeted discounting may not be sustainable and omits margin, retention, and long-term customer quality. memory_91 is weakest because it reports only week-one engagement and a first meaningful action, with no evidence of qualified revenue, retention, or durable effects.
